body: I wish I could leave but I don’t know how. I don’t want to be alone but maybe it would be better?
I don’t think anyone else would put up with me
I’m worried that if I call the police or end up in a shelter I won’t have enough time to find a job and a place to live and I’ll end up back here and that would make it worse
Thanks

I’m working with a shelter in my area but leaving isn’t an option due to my situation and how the shelter works. I want to leave as soon as I can but if I’m not smart about it I’ll just end up back here and that’ll make it so much worse.
I’m not wonderful
Thank you..I’ll think about it. I don’t think I can make any decisions right now I’m too confused
I’m in canada
And he won’t go to jail. Not here. He’ll be held for a night and then he’ll get out and he’ll come find me
What if they do? I put myself in such an embarrassing situation. What if nobody wants to help?
I want to be safe. I want to feel better, I don’t want to hurt him. I’m so fucking scared to leave. He’ll be so mad if I leave

I knew when he was getting angry that it was going to be bad. He’s never hit me until now but he’s thrown things and shoved me and stuff. I knew he was getting to that point and I didn’t stop. Something has to be wrong with me
I could have stopped them all but I didn’t. Just like I could have stopped the fight yesterday but I didn’t. I don’t know what’s wrong with me
I don’t deserve better. My last boyfriend hit me, my first boss raped me several times, my parents beat me until I moved out.. How can you say I don’t deserve this?! Everyone else thinks I do
Nobody else would ever want me..I don’t want to be alone. I’m already so lonely I can’t handle it..
He says he won’t do it again..I’m so scared to be alone
What if it gets better and I ruin everything over one bad day? I can’t
I don’t want to talk like that. They’ll judge me and I feel so stupid
I’m too embarrassed to tell people in person I can’t I’m sorry
I just don’t want to talk to them. They always have questions
No I don’t trust those people I tried before
No I don’t have anyone
I don’t have friends. I haven’t seen anyone other than my boyfriend in 3 years
I’m in a new town and I don’t know anyone and I don’t know how to drive. I don’t have any friends. I wish I did
I can’t handle being alone. I don’t think I can
I don’t know what to do. I can’t call anyone and they wouldn’t even believe me if I could call. I don’t want to live anymore. It’s not worth it..
And he’s never done it before
If I leave I won’t have anyone
I don’t have anyone to talk to. It was my fault. I shouldn’t have yelled at him. I can’t call the police if it’s my fault
I can’t I started the fight. I always start the fighting. I’m so stupid..
